title: Presentation Design and Delivery
overview: What distinguishes speeches and presentations that linger in our memories from those that quickly fade away? Is it the subject matter, the speaker, or the presentation materials? In this course, you'll discover how to leverage every available resource to transform your speeches and presentations from ordinary to captivating. By guiding you in crafting compelling introductions, coherent content, and impactful conclusions, the course aims to substantially enhance the effectiveness of your speeches and presentations, irrespective of the topic, audience, or media utilized
audience: Individuals seeking a tangible enhancement in their presentation skills through a practical, hands-on approach will find this workshop-style course valuable. It is especially beneficial for those engaged in sales, business development, or regular presentations to senior management
methodology: The course employs a combination of interactive techniques, including concise presentations by the consultant and participants, role plays (both rehearsed and impromptu), video playback of performances (where permissible), and feedback sessions conducted individually and in groups
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the primary causes of dull and ineffective presentations and implement strategies to address them
Employ a systematic and user-friendly approach to prepare for presentations
Construct presentations following the triple S rule
Demonstrate the appropriate verbal and non-verbal attributes crucial for impactful presentations
Identify key factors contributing to Public Speaking Anxiety (PSA) and adopt methods to alleviate them before presenting
Utilize commonly available visual aids to enhance and visually engage their presentations
